behaviors.description: Pass NUL-separated environment entries to a build command through a file descriptor.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build tree, installed runtime, descriptors containing empty values and spaces/equal signs.
behaviors.expected: Build probe reports exact descriptor values for both inputs and empty values remain defined; original metadata remains unchanged.

mappings.rationale: Two distinct descriptor payloads are observed inside the build command with no metadata mutation.

surface_assertions.rationale: Exact empty and nonempty descriptor values reach the build probe across two inputs.
